name: @activepieces/piece-send-it
description: Multi-platform social media publishing. Schedule and publish content to LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, and 30+ more platforms.

auth.description:
To get your SendIt API key:
1. Log in to your [SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**
3. Click **Create API Key** — the key is only shown once, so copy it immediately
4. Paste the key below (it starts with `sk_live_`)

publish_post.name: publish_post
publish_post.description: Publish content to social media platforms immediately

platforms.description: Select one or more social media platforms to publish to. Make sure your accounts are connected in the SendIt dashboard under **Settings > Connected Accounts**.

text.description: The text content of your post. Character limits vary by platform (e.g. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).

mediaUrl.description: A publicly accessible URL to an image (JPG, PNG, GIF) or video (MP4). **Required for Instagram and TikTok.** Images must be under 10 MB and videos under 100 MB.

mediaUrls.description: Add multiple publicly accessible image URLs to create a carousel post. Supported on Instagram and Threads. Add one URL per item.

mediaType.description: Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt misidentifies your media. Choose **Image** or **Video** to force a specific type.

aiMetadata.description: Immediately publishes a post (text plus optional image/video URL or a multi-image carousel) to one or more connected social platforms (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, and others). Choose this to post right now rather than at a future time (use Schedule Post for that). Requires at least one selected platform whose account is connected in SendIt; note Instagram and TikTok require a media URL. Not idempotent: each call publishes a new post.

schedule_post.name: schedule_post
schedule_post.description: Schedule content to be published at a future time

platforms.description: Select one or more social media platforms to publish to. Make sure your accounts are connected in the SendIt dashboard under **Settings > Connected Accounts**.

text.description: The text content of your post. Character limits vary by platform (e.g. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).

mediaUrl.description: A publicly accessible URL to an image (JPG, PNG, GIF) or video (MP4). **Required for Instagram and TikTok.** Images must be under 10 MB and videos under 100 MB.

scheduledTime.description: When to publish the post. Must be in the future. Times are interpreted in UTC — convert your local time if needed.

aiMetadata.description: Queues a post (text plus optional media URL) to be published at a specified future time on one or more connected social platforms. Choose this when publishing should be deferred; use Publish Post to send immediately. The scheduled time must be in the future and is interpreted in UTC. Not idempotent: each call creates a new scheduled post.

cancel_scheduled_post.name: cancel_scheduled_post
cancel_scheduled_post.description: Cancel a scheduled post before it is published

scheduleId.description: Select the scheduled post you want to act on. Only posts with a **Pending** status are listed.

auth.description:
To get your SendIt API key:
1. Log in to your [SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**
3. Click **Create API Key** — the key is only shown once, so copy it immediately
4. Paste the key below (it starts with `sk_live_`)

aiMetadata.description: Cancels a pending scheduled post by its schedule ID so it will not be published. Use this to call off a future post created by Schedule Post; only posts in Pending status can be cancelled. Idempotent: cancelling an already-cancelled or non-existent schedule leaves it in the same cancelled end state.

scheduleId.description: Select the scheduled post you want to act on. Only posts with a **Pending** status are listed.

auth.description:
To get your SendIt API key:
1. Log in to your [SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**
3. Click **Create API Key** — the key is only shown once, so copy it immediately
4. Paste the key below (it starts with `sk_live_`)

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a pending scheduled post right away instead of waiting for its scheduled time, identified by its schedule ID. Use this to push out a queued post early. Not idempotent: it performs an actual publish, so repeating the call can re-publish the content.

validate_content.name: validate_content
validate_content.description: Check if content meets platform requirements before publishing

platforms.description: Select one or more social media platforms to publish to. Make sure your accounts are connected in the SendIt dashboard under **Settings > Connected Accounts**.

text.description: The text content of your post. Character limits vary by platform (e.g. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).

mediaUrl.description: A publicly accessible URL to an image (JPG, PNG, GIF) or video (MP4). **Required for Instagram and TikTok.** Images must be under 10 MB and videos under 100 MB.

mediaUrls.description: Add multiple publicly accessible image URLs to create a carousel post. Supported on Instagram and Threads. Add one URL per item.

mediaType.description: Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt misidentifies your media. Choose **Image** or **Video** to force a specific type.

aiMetadata.description: Validates that a post (text plus optional media) meets the requirements of the selected social platforms, such as character limits and media rules, without publishing anything. Use this as a pre-flight check before Publish Post or Schedule Post. Idempotent: it is a read-only check with no side effects.

list_accounts.name: list_accounts
list_accounts.description: Get a list of connected social media accounts

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the social media accounts currently connected to the SendIt account. Use this to discover which platforms are available before publishing or scheduling, or to verify a connection exists. Takes no input. Idempotent: it is a read-only lookup.

list_scheduled_posts.name: list_scheduled_posts
list_scheduled_posts.description: Get a list of pending scheduled posts

platformFilter.description: Only return scheduled posts for a specific platform. Leave empty to see all platforms.

aiMetadata.description: Lists pending scheduled posts, optionally filtered to a single platform; leaving the platform filter empty returns scheduled posts across all platforms. Use this to find the schedule ID of a post you want to cancel or trigger early, or to review the publishing queue. Idempotent: it is a read-only list.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

post_published.name: post_published
post_published.description: Triggers when a post is successfully published to a platform

aiMetadata.description: Fires when SendIt successfully publishes a post to a connected social platform, representing a completed publication. Each event carries the platform, post ID, post URL, and content of the published post.

post_scheduled.name: post_scheduled
post_scheduled.description: Triggers when a post is scheduled for future publishing

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a post is queued in SendIt for future publishing, representing a newly created schedule. Each event carries the schedule ID, target platforms, content, and the scheduled publish time.

post_failed.name: post_failed
post_failed.description: Triggers when a post fails to publish to a platform

aiMetadata.description: Fires when SendIt fails to publish a post to a connected social platform, representing a failed publication attempt. Each event carries the platform, the post content, and an error message describing why it failed.

Multi-platform social media publiceren. Plan en publiceer inhoud naar LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, en nog 30+ andere platformen.
nl.To get your SendIt API key:\n1. Log in t:
Om uw Sendit API-sleutel te verkrijgen:
1. Log in op uw [SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Ga naar **Instellingen > API Keys**
3. Klik **Maak API-sleutel** - de sleutel wordt maar één keer weergegeven, kopieer deze onmiddellijk
4. Plak de onderstaande toets (deze begint met `sk_live_`)
nl.Publish content to social media platform: Publiceer direct inhoud naar sociale media platforms
nl.Schedule content to be published at a fu: Plan inhoud die gepubliceerd moet worden op een later tijdstip
nl.Cancel a scheduled post before it is pub: Annuleer een gepland bericht voordat het wordt gepubliceerd
nl.Check if content meets platform requirem: Controleer of de inhoud voldoet aan de platformvereisten voor publicatie
nl.Get a list of connected social media acc: Krijg een lijst met verbonden sociale media accounts
nl.Get a list of pending scheduled posts: Krijg een lijst met geplande posts in behandeling
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.Select one or more social media platform: Selecteer een of meer sociale media platforms om mee te publiceren. Zorg ervoor dat uw accounts zijn verbonden in het SendIt dashboard onder **Instellingen > Gekoppelde accounts**.
nl.The text content of your post. Character: De tekstinhoud van je bericht. Karakter limieten variëren per platform (bijv. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).
nl.A publicly accessible URL to an image (J: Een publiekelijk toegankelijke URL naar een afbeelding (JPG, PNG, GIF) of video (MP4). **Vereist voor Instagram en TikTok.** Afbeeldingen moeten onder de 10 MB liggen en video's onder de 100 MB.
nl.Add multiple publicly accessible image U: Voeg meerdere publiekelijk toegankelijke afbeelding-URL's toe om een carrousel post te maken. Ondersteund op Instagram en Threads. Voeg één URL per item toe.
nl.Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Verlaat als **Auto-detect** tenzij SendIt uw media verkeerd identificeert. Kies **Image** of **Video** om een specifiek type af te dwingen.
nl.When to publish the post. Must be in the: Wanneer het bericht moet worden gepubliceerd. Moet in de toekomst zijn. Tijden worden geïnterpreteerd in UTC - converteer je lokale tijd indien nodig.
nl.Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Selecteer het geplande bericht waarop u wilt reageren. Alleen berichten met de status **In behandeling** worden weergegeven.
nl.Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Geeft alleen geplande berichten terug voor een specifiek platform. Laat leeg om alle platformen te zien.
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.
Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.
nl.HEAD: HOOFD
nl.Triggers when a post is successfully pub: Triggert wanneer een bericht succesvol is gepubliceerd naar een platform
nl.Triggers when a post is scheduled for fu: Triggert wanneer een bericht is gepland voor toekomstige publicatie
nl.Triggers when a post fails to publish to: Triggert wanneer een bericht niet publiceert naar een platform

Multiplattform Social Media Publishing. Planen und veröffentlichen Sie Inhalte auf LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X und mehr als 30 Plattformen.
de.To get your SendIt API key:\n1. Log in t:
Um Ihren SendIt-API-Schlüssel zu erhalten:
1. Loggen Sie sich in Ihr [SendIt-Dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Gehen Sie zu **Einstellungen > API Keys**
3. Klicken Sie auf **API-Schlüssel erstellen** — der Schlüssel wird nur einmal angezeigt, also kopieren Sie ihn sofort
4. Fügen Sie den folgenden Schlüssel ein (er beginnt mit `sk_live_`)
de.Schedule content to be published at a fu: Inhalte planen, die zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt veröffentlicht werden sollen
de.Cancel a scheduled post before it is pub: Einen geplanten Beitrag abbrechen, bevor er veröffentlicht wird
de.Check if content meets platform requirem: Prüfen Sie, ob Inhalte die Anforderungen der Plattform erfüllen, bevor sie veröffentlicht werden
de.Get a list of connected social media acc: Eine Liste mit verbundenen Social Media Konten erhalten
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Select one or more social media platform: Wählen Sie eine oder mehrere Social-Media-Plattformen aus, für die Sie veröffentlichen möchten. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre Konten im SendIe-Dashboard unter **Einstellungen > Verbundene Konten** verbunden sind.
de.The text content of your post. Character: Der Textinhalt Ihres Beitrags. Charakterbegrenzungen variieren je nach Plattform (z.B. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).
de.A publicly accessible URL to an image (J: Eine öffentlich zugängliche URL zu einem Bild (JPG, PNG, GIF) oder Video (MP4). **Benötigt für Instagram und TikTok.** Bilder müssen unter 10 MB und Videos unter 100 MB betragen.
de.Add multiple publicly accessible image U: Fügen Sie mehrere öffentlich zugängliche Bild-URLs hinzu, um einen Karussell-Beitrag zu erstellen. Unterstützt auf Instagram und Threads. Fügen Sie eine URL pro Element hinzu.
de.Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Lassen Sie als **Auto-Erkennung** es sei denn, dass Sendende Ihre Medien falsch identifiziert. Wählen Sie **Bild** oder **Video** um einen bestimmten Typ zu erzwingen.
de.When to publish the post. Must be in the: Wenn der Beitrag veröffentlicht werden soll. Die Zeiten werden in UTC interpretiert — die lokale Zeit bei Bedarf konvertieren.
de.Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Wähle den geplanten Beitrag aus, auf dem du handeln möchtest. Nur Beiträge mit einem **ausstehenden** Status sind aufgelistet.
de.Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Gibt nur geplante Beiträge für eine bestimmte Plattform zurück. Lassen Sie leer, um alle Plattformen zu sehen.
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.
de.HEAD: HEAD
de.Triggers when a post is successfully pub: Löst aus, wenn ein Beitrag erfolgreich auf einer Plattform veröffentlicht wurde
de.Triggers when a post is scheduled for fu: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Beitrag für zukünftige Veröffentlichungen geplant ist
de.Triggers when a post fails to publish to: Löst aus, wenn ein Beitrag nicht auf einer Plattform veröffentlicht wird

Édition de médias sociaux multi-plateformes. Programmez et publiez du contenu sur LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X et plus de 30 plates-formes supplémentaires.
fr.To get your SendIt API key:\n1. Log in t:
Pour obtenir votre clé API SendIt :
1. Connectez-vous à votre [tableau de bord Sendit](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Allez dans **Paramètres > Clés API**
3. Cliquez sur **Créer une clé API** — la clé n'est affichée qu'une seule fois, alors copiez-la immédiatement
4. Collez la clé ci-dessous (elle commence par `sk_live_`)
fr.Publish content to social media platform: Publier le contenu sur les plateformes de réseaux sociaux immédiatement
fr.Schedule content to be published at a fu: Planifier le contenu à publier à un moment futur
fr.Cancel a scheduled post before it is pub: Annuler une publication planifiée avant sa publication
fr.Check if content meets platform requirem: Vérifier si le contenu satisfait aux exigences de la plateforme avant sa publication
fr.Get a list of connected social media acc: Obtenir une liste des comptes de réseaux sociaux connectés
fr.Get a list of pending scheduled posts: Obtenir une liste des messages en attente
fr.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Passer un appel API personnalisé à un endpoint spécifique
fr.Select one or more social media platform: Sélectionnez une ou plusieurs plateformes de médias sociaux à publier. Assurez-vous que vos comptes sont connectés dans le tableau de bord SendIt sous **Paramètres > Comptes connectés**.
fr.The text content of your post. Character: Le contenu du texte de votre message. Les limites de caractères varient par plateforme (par exemple X/Twitter : 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).
fr.A publicly accessible URL to an image (J: Une URL accessible au public à une image (JPG, PNG, GIF) ou vidéo (MP4). **Requis pour Instagram et TikTok.** Les images doivent être inférieures à 10 Mo et les vidéos de moins de 100 Mo.
fr.Add multiple publicly accessible image U: Ajouter plusieurs URL d'images accessibles au public pour créer un message de carrousel. Pris en charge sur Instagram et Threads. Ajouter une URL par élément.
fr.Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Laisser comme **détection automatique** à moins que SendIt n'identifie mal vos médias. Choisissez **Image** ou **Vidéo** pour forcer un type spécifique.
fr.When to publish the post. Must be in the: Quand publier le message. Doit être dans le futur. Les temps sont interprétés en UTC — convertissez votre heure locale si nécessaire.
fr.Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Sélectionnez le message planifié sur lequel vous souhaitez agir. Seuls les messages avec un statut **En attente** sont listés.
fr.Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Renvoie uniquement les messages planifiés pour une plateforme spécifique. Laissez vide pour voir toutes les plateformes.
fr.Authorization headers are injected autom: Les Headers d'autorisation sont injectés automatiquement à partir de votre connexion.
Activer pour les fichiers comme les PDFs, les images, etc.
fr.HEAD: HEAD
fr.Triggers when a post is successfully pub: Déclenche lorsqu'un message est publié avec succès sur une plateforme
fr.Triggers when a post is scheduled for fu: Déclenche lorsqu'un message est programmé pour une publication future
fr.Triggers when a post fails to publish to: Déclenche lorsqu'un message ne parvient pas à publier sur une plateforme

Publicación de redes sociales multiplataforma. Programe y publique contenido en LinkedIn, Instagram, Hilos, TikTok, X y más de 30 plataformas más.
es.To get your SendIt API key:\n1. Log in t:
Para obtener su clave API de SendIt:
1. Inicie sesión en su [panel de control de SendIt](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Vaya a **Ajustes > Claves API**
3. Haga clic en **Crear clave API** — la clave sólo se muestra una vez, así que cópiela inmediatamente
4. Pega la siguiente clave (comienza con `sk_live_`)
es.Publish content to social media platform: Publicar contenido en plataformas de redes sociales inmediatamente
es.Schedule content to be published at a fu: Programar contenido para ser publicado en un momento futuro
es.Cancel a scheduled post before it is pub: Cancelar una publicación programada antes de que sea publicada
es.Check if content meets platform requirem: Comprobar si el contenido cumple con los requisitos de la plataforma antes de publicar
es.Get a list of connected social media acc: Obtener una lista de cuentas de redes sociales conectadas
es.Get a list of pending scheduled posts: Obtener una lista de mensajes pendientes programados
es.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Hacer una llamada API personalizada a un extremo específico
es.No Error on Failure: No hay ningún error en fallo
es.Select one or more social media platform: Selecciona una o más plataformas de redes sociales para publicar. Asegúrate de que tus cuentas están conectadas en el panel de control de SendIt en **Ajustes > Cuentas conectadas**.
es.The text content of your post. Character: The text content of your post. Character limits vary by platform (e.g. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).
es.A publicly accessible URL to an image (J: Una URL de acceso público a una imagen (JPG, PNG, GIF) o vídeo (MP4). **Requerido para Instagrama y TikTok.** Las imágenes deben ser menores de 10 MB y vídeos menores de 100 MB.
es.Add multiple publicly accessible image U: Añadir múltiples URLs de imágenes accesibles públicamente para crear un post de carrusel. Soportado en Instagram y Hilos. Añadir una URL por artículo.
es.Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Deja como **detección automática** a menos que SendIt no identifique correctamente tus medios. Elige **Imagen** o **Video** para forzar un tipo específico.
es.When to publish the post. Must be in the: Cuándo publicar la publicación. Debe ser en el futuro. Los tiempos se interpretan en UTC — convertir su hora local si es necesario.
es.Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Selecciona la publicación programada en la que quieres actuar. Sólo se listan las publicaciones con un estado **Pendiente**.
es.Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Devolver sólo mensajes programados para una plataforma específica. Dejar en blanco para ver todas las plataformas.

Activar para archivos como PDFs, imágenes, etc.

es.Triggers when a post is scheduled for fu: Dispara cuando una publicación está programada para futuras publicaciones
es.Triggers when a post fails to publish to: Dispara cuando un post no se puede publicar en una plataforma

zh.Select one or more social media platform: Select one or more social media platforms to publish to. Make sure your accounts are connected in the SendIt dashboard under **Settings > Connected Accounts**.
zh.The text content of your post. Character: The text content of your post. Character limits vary by platform (e.g. X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).
zh.A publicly accessible URL to an image (J: A publicly accessible URL to an image (JPG, PNG, GIF) or video (MP4). **Required for Instagram and TikTok.** Images must be under 10 MB and videos under 100 MB.
zh.Add multiple publicly accessible image U: Add multiple publicly accessible image URLs to create a carousel post. Supported on Instagram and Threads. Add one URL per item.
zh.Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt misidentifies your media. Choose **Image** or **Video** to force a specific type.
zh.When to publish the post. Must be in the: When to publish the post. Must be in the future. Times are interpreted in UTC — convert your local time if needed.
zh.Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Select the scheduled post you want to act on. Only posts with a **Pending** status are listed.
zh.Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Only return scheduled posts for a specific platform. Leave empty to see all platforms.

pt.To get your SendIt API key:\n1. Log in t:
Para obter sua chave de API do SendIt
1. Faça login no seu [Painel SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Vá para **Configurações > Chaves de API**
3. Clique em **Criar chave de API** — a chave é mostrada apenas uma vez, então copie-a imediatamente
4. Cole a chave abaixo (ela começa com `sk_live_`)
pt.Publish content to social media platform: Publicar conteúdo em plataformas de mídia social imediatamente
pt.Schedule content to be published at a fu: Agende o conteúdo a ser publicado em uma hora futura
pt.Cancel a scheduled post before it is pub: Cancelar uma publicação agendada antes de ser publicada
pt.Check if content meets platform requirem: Marque se o conteúdo atende aos requisitos da plataforma antes de publicá-lo
pt.Get a list of connected social media acc: Obter uma lista de redes sociais conectadas
pt.Get a list of pending scheduled posts: Obter uma lista de postagens agendadas pendentes
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.Select one or more social media platform: Selecione uma ou mais plataformas de mídia social para publicar. Certifique-se de que suas contas estão conectadas no painel do SendIt em **Configurações > Contas conectadas**.
pt.The text content of your post. Character: O conteúdo do texto da sua mensagem. Os limites de caracteres variam por plataforma (por exemplo, X/Twitter: 280, LinkedIn: 3000, Instagram: 2200).
pt.A publicly accessible URL to an image (J: Uma URL publicamente acessível para uma imagem (JPG, PNG, GIF) ou vídeo (MP4). **Requerido para o Instagram e TikTok.** As imagens devem ter menos de 10 MB e vídeos menores de 100 MB.
pt.Add multiple publicly accessible image U: Adicione várias URLs de imagens acessíveis ao público para criar uma mensagem em carrossel. Suportado no Instagram e Threads. Adicione uma URL por item.
pt.Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Deixe como **Detectar automaticamente** a menos que o SendIt desidentifique mal sua mídia. Escolha **Imagem** ou **Vídeo** para forçar um tipo específico.
pt.When to publish the post. Must be in the: Quando publicar o post. Deve ser no futuro. Os tempos são interpretados em UTC — converta o seu horário local, se necessário.
pt.Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Selecione a postagem agendada que você deseja agir. Apenas postagens com status de **Pendente** são listadas.
pt.Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Só retornar posts agendados para uma plataforma específica. Deixe em branco para ver todas as plataformas.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
